correctness.rationale: Exact conditional probability of simultaneous root and leaf attachment is Q_n/[2(n-1)] (and not product of marginal probabilities). The resulting recursion C_(n+1)-C_n=a_n² d_n l_n-a_n q_n follows algebraically and is checked by exact rational enumeration to n=9. Its substitution gives nonnegative and strict positive increments, and central-binomial/Stirling asymptotics yield the sharp constant. Second moment identities for both variables imply the claimed correlation; no infinite assertion relies on finite enumeration.

value.rationale: The oldest hub degree and total terminal-node count are independent axes of the standard network model. The exact all-n sign, covariance of order sqrt(n), limiting sensitivity C_n/E[D_n]→1/3 and vanishing correlation quantify a nontrivial local-to-global dependence, contrasting bounded covariance in uniform attachment; this is structural statistical information not a routine marginal recomputation.
